name: Times cryptic crossword, Times Crosswords book 1 No 118

clue.text: Where hammer falls promptly
To catch girl, ring is needed
Fine point producing blow-out
Fish around to catch by hand — that’s said to be “hands-on”
Pierrot undaunted, to some extent, in impressive hall
Dictionary I study in pursuit of old word for “law”
A cold part of London — not a leg to be seen — just part of one
Of course declarer’s upset about this much older partner
Speeds between points in darkness
Dog seen to bare teeth without backing off
In agreement with letter? Not I, for one
As form of punishment, king has knight dismissed
No way in — that’s bad
Not 10 to three, roughly one to 100
Away on holiday, achieved delivery
Food and drink
Caught up in net, dangle, squirming
Satisfy animal, stuffing it with vegetables
Bill, a mischievous creature, climbing into water channel
Milky fluid from past times
After wine, clergymen used to show penitence
Pupil no longer has desire for geometric construction
Rain’s held off — bad luck!
One carping, having a pound, keeping it quiet
Distracted if centre is out of position
Pleasingly simple lament cut short by worker
Close match, in which one retires
Warning signal — has to be a trick
Professional co-ordinates authorisation for agent
Runs into vessel’s bow
